mbmm: Mechanistic Bayesian Mixture Models for Latent Kinetic States

Source: R/mbmm-package.R
mbmm-package.Rd

Estimates how a covariate shifts the probability of a latent biological state that is expressed through a longitudinal trajectory rather than observed directly. Each state is represented by a population of mechanistic trajectories (a "bank"); integrating a censoring-aware trajectory likelihood over that population gives a class likelihood, and a covariate-dependent gate supplies the prior state probability. An EM algorithm estimates the gate by weighted logistic regression on the resulting posterior responsibilities, so participants whose state is uncertain contribute at the weight the evidence warrants. Includes the eclipse-phase target-cell-limited viral model and the reduced Andraud prime-boost antibody model used in the accompanying manuscript.
